definitions.explanation: The spreading of disease from one person or organism to another.
The figurative spreading of feelings or behaviors from one person to others.

examples.japanese: {伝染|でんせん}⟦{病|びょう}→病：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I am careful about infectious diseases.

⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{伝染|でんせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
この⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧へ{伝染|でんせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This disease is transmitted from person to person.

examples.english: Her anxiety spread to those around her.

notes:
{伝染|でんせん} refers to the transmission of disease from one organism to another, and also the figurative spread of emotions or behaviors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝染|でんせん}する: to spread, to be transmitted
- {伝染|でんせん}⟦{病|びょう}→病：noentry⟧: infectious disease
- {伝染|でんせん}{力|りょく}: infectivity
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧{伝染|でんせん}: airborne transmission

USAGE:
Commonly used for emotions and involuntary actions that spread from person to person: ⟦あくび→欠伸：06484_akubi⟧が{伝染|でんせん}する (yawning is contagious), ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧が{伝染|でんせん}する (laughter is contagious), ⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧が{伝染|でんせん}する (anxiety spreads).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧: infection (medical, more technical — {感染|かんせん}する is more common in modern medical usage)
- ⟦{蔓延|まんえん}→蔓延：09460_manen⟧: widespread spread, rampancy
- {伝染|でんせん} has a slightly older feel; {感染|かんせん} is now preferred in clinical contexts
